name: How should I prepare my home before shower installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before shower installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installation crew arrives, clear all toiletries, towels, rugs, and decorative items from the bathroom. Remove pictures or hanging items from walls adjacent to the bathroom, as wall vibrations during demolition can knock them loose. Ensure clear pathways through hallways and stairs so technicians can safely move materials, tools, and debris. You should also confirm where your home's main water shutoff valve is located, as water service to the bathroom or the whole home will be turned off periodically during plumbing rough-ins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal items, remove wall hangings on adjoining rooms, clear a walking path for the crew, and locate your main water shutoff valve.
